# 6G显存建议使用fp8模型
## 经过我测试，本地6G显存使用fp8模型可以直接生成2048*2048分辨率图片（注意更新到最新版comfyui）

# 6G VRAM recommended to use fp8 model
## After my testing, local 6G VRAM can directly generate 2048*2048 resolution images using an fp8 model (note to update to the latest version of comfyui)

# 6G显存用户放大分辨率建议小于2K
# 6G VRAM users are recommended to set a resolution smaller than 2K
# 6G显存用户vae分块分辨率建议设置为512或以下
# 6G VRAM users are advised to set the VAE block resolution to 512 or lower
